title: Learning to Diagnose and Correct Moral Errors: Towards Enhancing Moral Sensitivity in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmarks focus on general moral sensitivity, including diagnosing and correcting direct toxic language, indirect social biases (gender, disability, nationality), and harmful content from jailbreak prompts.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on general moral sensitivity in LLMs, unrelated to specific religious contexts.
